nodes.name: HR Termination Webhook
nodes.notes: Triggered by HR system (e.g. Workday, BambooHR) on employee termination. Must include: employee_id, email, manager_email, effective_date, reason

nodes.name: Disable Active Directory Account
nodes.notes: Replace URL with your AD management endpoint (e.g. Graph API or internal AD REST service)

nodes.name: Revoke AWS IAM Keys
nodes.notes: Use AWS SDK via n8n's AWS credential type for production

nodes.name: Revoke VPN Certificate
nodes.notes: Adapt to your VPN provider: OpenVPN Access Server, Cisco ASA, Palo Alto GlobalProtect

meta.description: Zero-lag user offboarding. Simultaneously disables AD, Okta, AWS, Azure, and VPN access on HR termination event. Creates compliance evidence ticket. SLA target: < 15 minutes.
